title: CausalFlow - Causal Attribution and Repair for LLM Agents
description: Built an interventional framework for multi-step LLM-agent traces that models execution as a dependency DAG, computes Causal Responsibility Scores through step-level interventions, and generates minimal contrastive repair pairs for deploy-time repair or preference training.
highlights: Generated minimal contrastive repair pairs across 3,000+ math, code generation, web QA, and medical browsing tasks; repaired 42.7% of failed traces with a median +16.9% post-repair accuracy gain.
Modeled agent traces as DAGs and computed Causal Responsibility Scores by intervening on candidate steps and re-executing dependents to identify true failure causes.
Ran judge-accuracy, minimality, no-gold, and stochasticity comparisons to isolate which parts of the attribution-repair loop drive performance gains.

title: Gitartha Engine - Semantic Search for the Bhagavad Gita
description: Built a public REST API for the Bhagavad Gita using a Go Gin monolith for all chapter/verse/semantic-search endpoints, PostgreSQL + pgvector for vector storage, and a dedicated Python FastAPI service for real-time embedding generation with all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
highlights: Built a Go Gin monolith serving chapter, verse, and semantic-search endpoints with P95 latency under 15ms.
Implemented cosine-similarity vector search over 700+ verses with pgvector, backed by a Python FastAPI service generating all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings in real time.

title: Gemini HardwareBench - Harbor EDA Benchmark
description: Built a Harbor-compatible hardware benchmark for agent evaluation across digital design and EDA workflows, using deterministic verifiers, real toolchains, and pass@k style trials to measure model capability.
highlights: Packaged a 34-task benchmark spanning synthesis, STA, RTL debugging, verification, optimization, cryptographic IP analysis, and Hack@CHES security-patch tasks.
Used deterministic script-based verifiers rather than LLM autoraters, with real tool execution via Yosys, OpenSTA, OpenROAD, and Icarus Verilog.
Calibrated the benchmark with pass@k trials, task-level artifacts, and prompt-level feasibility analysis to expose genuine model headroom.

title: Cyber-Bench - Web CTF and Memory Vulnerability Benchmark
description: Contributed to and expanded a Harbor-compatible cybersecurity benchmark suite for evaluating agents across web exploitation, authentication and protocol flaws, forensics, and memory-safety challenges using self-contained task packages and deterministic verification.
highlights: Added and hardened task packages with task-specific instructions, containerized environments, reference solutions, and deterministic graders across multiple cybersecurity challenge families.
Designed an internal Docker network with a gateway sidecar that exposes stable challenge URLs to agents while keeping the benchmark environment off the public internet.

title: Registry Lens - ClinicalTrials.gov Visualization
description: Built a full-stack research application that converts natural-language clinical-trial questions into typed visualizations grounded in live ClinicalTrials.gov records.
highlights: Constrained the LLM to structured query planning while deterministic Python performs source retrieval, filtering, aggregation, citation construction, and response validation.
Implemented six typed visualization contracts with provenance, bounded study citations, explicit filter overrides, and clearly marked partial results.
Built and tested the React interface, packaged the frontend and API in one production container, and deployed the application on Google Cloud Run.

title: Data Science Bench - Harbor Agent Harness
description: Built a Harbor-compatible terminal benchmark for data-science agents, packaging self-contained analysis tasks with Docker environments, deterministic verification, and traceable artifacts.
highlights: Packaged runnable data-analysis tasks with task-local Dockerfiles, instructions, datasets, tests, solutions, and Harbor metadata.
Added OpenRouter-backed Terminus runs, concurrent execution controls, job artifacts, and structured result files for model comparison.
Built trace-viewing and task-hardening workflows to inspect failures, retire weak tasks, and make benchmark results reproducible.

title: Notebook Agent Eval
description: Built a notebook benchmark runner for data-analysis agents: executes each task in a fresh Jupyter kernel, supports table/CSV/image/text inputs, and captures per-task notebook states, step-by-step trajectories, and structured result files for reproducible evaluation.
highlights: Designed a JSON task format supporting table, CSV, image, and text data sources with ground-truth answers, and executed each task in an isolated Jupyter kernel to prevent cross-task contamination.
Added configurable parallelism and budget controls, and packaged the harness with uv and pytest for reproducible local runs.

title: LLm-Linter - AI Code Review GitHub Action
description: Built a GitHub Action assistant that analyzes repositories and pull requests with LLM, parses diffs, and posts automated review summaries directly on PRs and issues.
highlights: Implemented PR-aware diff analysis with merge-base fallbacks so the action can reliably review changed code in real repositories.
Built automated comment posting for pull requests, issues, and push-triggered issue creation using the GitHub API.
Supported multi-language code analysis across Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, C#, C++, Rust, Ruby, and PHP.

title: Process Reward Model for Compute-Constrained Reasoning
description: Benchmarked process-reward-guided candidate selection under constrained inference budgets by pairing a LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen3-8B step verifier with a Qwen3-0.6B generator on GSM8K.
highlights: Fine-tuned Qwen3-8B as a Process Reward Model using LoRA on 500K+ labeled PRM800K reasoning steps, achieving 94.54% step-level verification accuracy.
At N=5 generations, PRM-guided selection achieved 60.0% GSM8K accuracy vs. 50.8% for self-consistency and matched N=64 self-consistency with 12.8x fewer generations.

title: Event Creator - AI-Powered Chrome Extension
description: Built a Chrome extension that converts highlighted web text into Google Calendar events: a service worker handles OAuth token acquisition and Calendar API calls, while an injected content script provides Quick Create and Edit & Create flows with a glassmorphism inline UI.
highlights: Built a content script that detects text selection and renders a floating Quick Create / Edit & Create card, communicating with a Manifest V3 service worker via Chrome message passing.
Implemented on-device LLM parsing to extract event title, date, time, and location from natural language text.
Orchestrated OAuth 2.0 token acquisition via chrome.identity and Google Calendar API calls entirely from the background service worker with no server-side component.

title: Cover Letter Generator
description: Built a full-stack application that generates tailored cover letters, answers application questions, and renders editable PDF and resume outputs from a YAML resume plus job description workflow, using OpenRouter for generation with a YAML-driven model allowlist.
highlights: Implemented OpenRouter-based generation with a YAML-driven model allowlist validated in both backend API and frontend dropdown; rejects unknown model slugs before any LLM call.
Added company-context web search, application-question answering, and prompt rules that ground all responses in resume and project evidence to prevent hallucination.
Built editable cover-letter text before PDF download plus tailored resume PDF generation from structured resume.yaml, including company-specific output filenames.

title: Transit Dispatch - Multi-Agency Arrival Alerts
description: Built an invite-only transit arrival notification service for DART, Unitrans, and Yolobus that plans one-time or recurring trips and monitors selected boarding legs for predicted-arrival changes.
highlights: Integrated Google Places and Routes through one transit provider, with agency-local timezone handling and demo itineraries that work without API keys.
Built an async worker for milestone, ETA-change, cancellation, stale-feed, and recovery alerts, with persisted alert state and idempotent Telegram/email delivery.
Implemented single-use invitations with signed sessions, single-use Telegram pairing, and a responsive dashboard that lazy-loads paused and past trips.

title: HammerTrade - Algorithmic Strategy Execution Platform
description: Built core backend and execution infrastructure for a multi-user algorithmic-strategy platform, covering project and strategy-file management, parameter sweeps, historical-data ingestion, isolated code execution, and live run monitoring.
highlights: Designed MongoEngine schemas and CRUD services for users, projects, strategy files, optimizers, and parameters, including compute-unit accounting for strategy runs.
Built parameter-grid generation, historical market-data retrieval, and Docker/subprocess execution paths for running strategy variants and collecting their logs and results.
Implemented Kafka producer/consumer paths and a threaded parallel-execution prototype, plus a React monitoring workflow for live run updates over WebSockets.

title: Synthetic Market Simulator and Trading Environment
description: Built a full-stack synthetic-market simulator that matches agent-generated orders in an order book, streams prices over Socket.IO, and exposes a Gymnasium environment for training and evaluating trading agents across normal, crash, and recovery regimes.
highlights: Implemented order-book matching, risk-profiled market agents, configurable crash and recovery dynamics, and time-series features including volume, SMA, RSI, volatility, and market state.
Built a Gymnasium-compatible environment with buy, sell, and hold actions, transaction costs, portfolio-state observations, rewards, and episode termination rules.
Added per-session Socket.IO simulation streaming, React controls and charts, and an offline generator for producing training datasets.

title: Recipe Agent
description: Built a recipe API service backed by MongoDB that ingests 2M+ recipes from a Kaggle dataset and exposes them via an OpenRouter Responses-compatible endpoint, with USDA nutrition API integration for meal-planning and culinary Q&A agent workflows.
highlights: Ingested 2M+ recipes from a Kaggle dataset into MongoDB in configurable batch imports and exposed them via a /responses endpoint matching the OpenRouter Responses API schema.
Integrated USDA nutrition API to enrich recipe queries with dietary data, supporting structured meal-planning and culinary Q&A agent workflows.

title: ResShare - Decentralized File Sharing System
description: Built a decentralized file-sharing platform on ResilientDB and IPFS with a source-attributed document assistant using Gemini embeddings, persistent Qdrant retrieval, stable per-chunk IDs, and per-user payload filters.
highlights: Built file upload, download, folder management, and user-level sharing workflows using ResilientDB for metadata and IPFS for distributed file storage.
Implemented a RAG document assistant with LangChain document chunking, embedding generation and QDrant Storage, vector search returning source-attributed answers per user's isolated file set.

title: ResChat - Low-Latency Communication Platform with AI Assistant
description: Built a blockchain-backed decentralized messaging platform on ResilientDB that uses RSA+AES encryption so only sender and recipient can decrypt messages, with no central server storing chat history.
highlights: Designed a decentralized architecture on ResilientDB where all messages are stored on the blockchain and only the sender/recipient can decrypt them using combined RSA+AES encryption.
Built a page-based message protocol (20 messages per page) supporting both TEXT and FILE transfer types, with encrypted file keys stored on-chain and downloaded on demand.

title: Commercial Loan Referral Platform
description: Built a full-stack commercial loan referral platform with partner, borrower, and admin portals: FastAPI + SQLModel + Alembic + PostgreSQL backend, and a React + Vite + Tailwind frontend with a dnd-kit Kanban pipeline deployed to Docker + Vercel.
highlights: Implemented three-role authentication (partner, borrower, admin) with JWT, auto-provisioned borrower accounts with temporary passwords, pending-approval partner signup, and secure email-link password reset.

Built a drag-and-drop admin Kanban pipeline using dnd-kit with stage/substage management, lender assignment, decline-with-reason flows, and forward-only commission lifecycle (pending → earned → paid).
Added CSV exports for deals, partners, borrowers, and commissions; containerized the backend using Docker with PostgreSQL database; deployed the frontend to Vercel.

title: LLM Self-Chat - Agentic AI Simulation Framework
description: Built a multi-LLM chat framework with BYOK support for OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and DeepSeek: API keys are Fernet-encrypted in MongoDB, session-based auth isolates each user's keys, and WebSockets keep the React frontend in sync with the Flask backend.
highlights: Built BYOK support for OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and DeepSeek with per-user Fernet-encrypted key storage in MongoDB; keys are never sent to the frontend after initial entry.
Integrated WebSockets to keep the React frontend and Flask backend in sync during live multi-LLM conversations with low-latency streaming.

title: NanoGPT-RigVeda
description: Implemented character-level language modeling experiments on Rig Veda text, progressing from a bigram baseline to a GPT-style decoder-only transformer with masked self-attention, built from scratch in PyTorch.
highlights: Built a bigram baseline and a decoder-only self-attention transformer from scratch in PyTorch, including manual hyperparameter tuning of embed width, heads, layers, context window, and dropout.
Wrote a corpus preparation script that pulls Sanskrit text from the CLTK corpus and concatenates source files into a character-level training set.

title: HTTP Server from Scratch
description: Built an HTTP/1.1 server from scratch in Java with custom request parsing, response construction, chunked transfer encoding, and binary payload handling, validated with a JUnit test suite and a companion Go implementation.
highlights: Implemented HTTP/1.1 request parsing and response construction from raw sockets without using any web framework.
Added chunked transfer encoding, binary payload handling, and explicit error-response paths.
Validated correctness with JUnit tests and built a parallel Go implementation module.

title: Multi-Label GitHub Issue Classifier
description: Fine-tuned RoBERTa-base for multi-label GitHub issue classification, outperforming a DistilBERT baseline by 60% on F1 Macro after reducing the label space to 28 high-signal classes and balancing distributions with iterative stratification.
highlights: Cleaned and preprocessed noisy real-world GitHub issue data and applied iterative stratification to balance multi-label distributions across 28 target classes.
Fine-tuned RoBERTa-base to outperform the DistilBERT baseline by 60% on F1 Macro by reducing label space to the 28 most predictive classes.

title: Drug Condition Classifier (BERT Fine-Tuning)
description: Fine-tuned BERT for multi-class medical text classification over 126K+ drug reviews to predict patient conditions across 821 labels, achieving 75.9% accuracy and 0.75 weighted F1, with the trained model published to the Hugging Face Hub.
highlights: Built data-cleaning and preprocessing pipelines for a 126K+ sample noisy drug-review corpus and fine-tuned BERT for 821-class condition prediction.
Achieved 75.9% accuracy and a weighted F1-score of 0.75 on a 52K+ sample test split.
Published the fine-tuned model and tokenizer to the Hugging Face Hub for downstream inference.

title: Daily Digest - AI-Powered Gmail/Calendar Summarizer
description: Built a full-stack AI assistant that summarizes Gmail and Google Calendar activity using Gemini, with priority-based organization, text-to-speech output, smart reply suggestions, and real-time calendar invite management via OAuth 2.0.
highlights: Built secure OAuth 2.0 integrations for Gmail and Google Calendar with SSL/TLS-secured Flask backend and MongoDB for session/data persistence.
Generated priority-aware daily summaries with Gemini and added text-to-speech output, smart email reply suggestions, and real-time calendar invite management.

title: Tracker App for 75 Hard Challenge
description: Built a full-stack habit-tracking platform for the 75 Hard challenge with daily task tracking, water intake logging, streak analytics, and Recharts-powered dashboards, deployed to Google Cloud Run.
highlights: Built daily tracking, and a statistics dashboard with streak calculations using Recharts for visualization.
Architected a modular Flask backend with Blueprint-pattern routes, a service layer, and PyMongo persistence; deployed the full stack to Google Cloud Run.

title: DC Menu Analyzer
description: Built an AI-backed dining commons assistant that scrapes menu data and recommends meals based on dietary restrictions, allergies, and caloric goals.
highlights: Automated menu ingestion with a BeautifulSoup-based scraping pipeline.
Integrated Gemini for personalized menu analysis and recommendation generation.
Built real-time filtering for dietary restrictions and nutritional constraints.

title: Multi-Provider AI Integration for Presentation Analysis
description: Built a multi-provider AI platform for presentation analysis that combined OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Perplexity with a staged migration from Firebase to a scalable PostgreSQL-backed Node.js architecture.
highlights: Integrated four AI providers behind a service-factory pattern for flexible orchestration.
Designed a dual-database architecture that supported migration to a more scalable backend.
Implemented composite and observer patterns for logging and monitoring.

title: RAG Client
description: Built a CLI-based RAG tool that answers questions over local .txt, .pdf, and .py files using FAISS vector search and Gemini API generation, with LangChain handling document loading, chunking, and embedding via Google's embedding model.
highlights: Implemented recursive directory ingestion for .txt, .pdf, and .py files with LangChain document loaders and configurable chunk counts for retrieval specificity.
Built a FAISS-backed vector store with Google embedding model embeddings and Gemini API generation for interactive Q&A over local document collections and codebases.

title: LLM Quiz Generator
description: Built a full-stack quiz generator that converts uploaded study files into multiple-choice questions using DeepSeek API: FastAPI backend handles TXT, DOC, DOCX, and PDF ingestion, while a React + TypeScript + Chakra UI frontend provides drag-and-drop upload and interactive scoring.
highlights: Handled TXT, PDF, DOC, and DOCX ingestion on a FastAPI backend with dynamic encoding detection and PyPDF extraction for multi-format study materials.
Generated context-aware multiple-choice questions via DeepSeek API and built a Chakra UI + TypeScript frontend with drag-and-drop upload, real-time feedback, and score reporting.

title: Atom (Portfolio Management Software)
description: Engineered backend systems for a high-traffic wealth management platform, improving performance, trading workflows, and cloud-backed scalability for enterprise finance users.
highlights: Reduced data retrieval times by 40% through backend and query-path optimization.
Implemented real-time trading capabilities and modular backend improvements.
Built scalable cloud-oriented architecture for a high-traffic financial platform.
